mira (partnerships): Quick sync: partners want a tight "one-flow" demo for Marketplace listing — SigmaCompute hardware + Nimbus SI + LangChain/LlamaIndex wiring to Redwood. Aim: 90s demo + reproducible sandbox repo.
jonas (devrel): Sounds good. Proposed flow: user query -> LangChain chain w/ LlamaIndex retriever -> call to gateway with structured tool response -> Redwood Dedicated on Sigma -> return JSON + Console metrics snapshot.
mira (partnerships): Yes. Keep it deterministic and replayable for the partner video. Also add a short eval to show quality parity vs hosted fallback.
alex (eng): Tech notes: will create a sample repo with Dockerfile, example .env, a lightweight dataset, and a tiny k6-like script to simulate ~5 req/sec for the Console latency graph. We'll include tags for model_id and partner_gateway.
samir (solutions): I'll write the demo script and partner-facing README. Need the gateway config block that shows region failover + auth header for the playbook.
alex (eng): Use this minimal demo snippet (placeholders):
```
# .env.demo
REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED_DEMO
GATEWAY_ENDPOINT=https://gateway.sandbox.sigmacompute.com/v1
PREFERRED_REGION=us-central-1
FALLBACK_REGION=us-west-2
```
Note: stress safe values, no real keys.
jonas (devrel): I'll assemble a LangChain template using AgentExecutor + a Retriever from LlamaIndex. Will include comments on chunk_size=512 and embedding model=small-embed for cost control.
samir (solutions): For the marketplace asset, we also want a short runbook: steps to reproduce, expected outputs, troubleshooting (common auth errors + region mismatch). I'll draft that.
alice (sales): Marketing asks for co-branded 1-pager bullets: what it solves, supported hardware, expected latency/cost figures, and a short customer quote placeholder. I can draft and iterate with partners. Need demo screenshots by Tue EOD.
mira (partnerships): Timeline: code freeze Mon EOD, dry run Tue, recording Wed. Is everyone good?
jonas (devrel): Yes — freeze by Mon EOD. I'll add an eval harness (3 prompts) that we can run against Dedicated and hosted fallback to show failure modes. Also add a notebook for reproducible results.
alex (eng): I'll push repo link and Docker image tag here by EOD today.
samir (solutions): I'll add a short section: "How to showcase Console: latency + token cost" with screenshots and the tiny load script.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: sandbox-demo-stack -> sigma-sandbox (build #439).
mira (partnerships): Awesome. I'll coordinate legal/co-brand and Nimbus for the recording time slot. Flag blockers here. :thumbsup:
